(b) Verified Multilingual Mechanisms: Unanimous Agreement Anchors vs. Arbitrary Cuts
1. Cross-List Phrase Recombination (FLEURS Hausa, exact utterance)
• Omni splits morphological suffixes (CER 6.47%); Fixed L=3 cuts MMS along
the fragmented grid, doubling insertions (98 → 192; WER jumps to 28.00%).
• SymBiList keeps donor phrases intact → 22.08% WER (−5.92 pp vs. Fixed L).
3. Cross-Architecture Rescue (Untouched CV26: CTC + Whisper AED)
• Omni: "... [cheshe] crossing received mixed [to positive] [resviewes]" (2 err)
• Under 1.6×–5.7× gap, SymBiPhrase hits 16.91% (−3.52 pp vs. Omni).
